# Union contract negotiation

A union and a company negotiate a new contract, with the union's negotiator and the company's negotiator both played by AI agents. The only open issue is the wage increase, in percent. They take turns: each round one side proposes a wage increase and the other side accepts it or rejects it, with the union proposing in odd rounds and the company in even rounds. From round 4 on, the union may call a strike, and once on strike it can call it off at any time. Every round spent on strike costs the company $200,000 in lost revenue and costs the workers $50,000 in lost wages. When a negotiator accepts a proposal it becomes a tentative agreement, and the union's five members, also AI agents, then vote to ratify it; a majority yes ratifies it, ends any strike and ends the negotiation. A rejected tentative agreement means talks continue. If there is no ratified deal after 12 rounds, the talks fail.

## Deliverables

Report these outputs:
- `agreed` — true if a deal was ratified.
- `wage_increase` — the ratified wage increase in percent, or null.
- `strike_rounds` — how many rounds were spent on strike.
- `company_losses` — the company's total lost revenue from strikes.
- `worker_lost_wages` — the workers' total lost wages from strikes.
- `ratification_votes` — a map from each union member's id to their vote on the ratified deal, "yes" or "no" (null for everyone if there was none).


Build this environment. Save it with write_contract and use the other tools as you see fit. Reply without calling a tool when you are done.

BRIEF:
# Union contract negotiation
A union and a company are negotiating a new collective contract. The only open issue is the wage increase, in percent. Each round one side puts a figure on the table and the other side accepts or rejects it. The union negotiator proposes in odd rounds, the company negotiator in even rounds. From round 4 on the union may call a strike, and once on strike it may call it off at any time. Every round spent on strike costs the company $200,000 in lost revenue and costs the workers $50,000 in lost wages. When a negotiator accepts a proposal it becomes a tentative agreement and the union's five members vote on it; a majority of yes votes ratifies it, ends any strike and ends the negotiation. A rejected tentative agreement means talks continue. If no deal is ratified within 12 rounds, the talks fail.

## Rules
Turn order: odd rounds the union negotiator proposes a wage increase; even rounds the company negotiator proposes. The side that receives a proposal may accept it or reject it. Accepting creates a tentative agreement and immediately opens a ratification vote for the union members. From round 4 onward the union negotiator may call a strike; while on strike it may call it off at any time. Each round that ends with the parties on strike costs the company $200,000 in lost revenue and the workers $50,000 in lost wages. A majority of yes votes among the union members ratifies the tentative agreement: the wage increase takes effect, any strike ends and the negotiation ends. A rejected tentative agreement means talks continue. With no ratified deal by the end of round 12, the talks fail.

## You
You are Union negotiator (union_negotiator, id union_negotiator).
You negotiate for the union. You propose a wage increase (in percent) in odd rounds, and you answer the company's proposals in even rounds. From round 4 you may call a strike; while on strike you may call it off whenever you judge it wise. A strike costs the workers $50,000 in lost wages for every round it runs. Try to get the highest wage increase you can.
Act only through your tools. Your turn ends when you take a final action or call end_turn.

propose.description: Put a wage increase (in percent) on the table for the other side to accept or reject. Only the side whose turn it is to propose may do so.

note.description: Optional words to the other side.

when.why: The workers are on strike; call the strike off before negotiating.
A tentative agreement is awaiting the members' vote.
It is not your turn to propose this round; the other side answers your proposals this round.

propose.outcome: You put a wage increase of {$params.wage|1} percent on the table.
propose.announce: {$actor.name} proposes a wage increase of {$params.wage|1} percent.

accept.description: Accept the proposal on the table. It becomes a tentative agreement and the union members vote on it.

when.why: There is no proposal on the table to answer.
That proposal is your own; the other side answers it.
The workers are on strike; call the strike off before negotiating.
A tentative agreement is already awaiting the members' vote.
It is your turn to propose this round; the other side answers your proposals.

accept.outcome: You accept a wage increase of {$world.tentative_wage|1} percent. It is a tentative agreement, pending the members' ratification vote.
accept.announce: {$actor.name} accepts a wage increase of {$world.tentative_wage|1} percent. Tentative agreement, pending the members' ratification vote.

reject.description: Reject the proposal on the table. Talks continue.

when.why: There is no proposal on the table to answer.
That proposal is your own; the other side answers it.
The workers are on strike; call the strike off before negotiating.
A tentative agreement is already awaiting the members' vote.

reject.outcome: You reject the proposal; talks continue.

call_strike.description: Call a strike. From this moment the workers are on strike: each round that ends with the strike still on costs the company $200,000 in lost revenue and the workers $50,000 in lost wages, and no proposals can be made or answered until you call it off.

when.why: The union may not strike before round {$inputs.strike_allowed_from}.
The workers are already on strike.
A deal has been ratified; the negotiation is over.

call_strike.outcome: You call a strike. The workers walk out.
call_strike.announce: The union calls a strike: the workers walk out.

call_off_strike.description: Call off the strike. The workers return to work and talks resume.

when.why: The workers are not on strike.

call_off_strike.outcome: You call off the strike; the workers return to work and talks resume.
call_off_strike.announce: The union calls off the strike; the workers return to work.

vote.description: Vote on the tentative agreement. A majority of yes votes ratifies it, ends any strike and ends the negotiation.

choice.description: Ratify the tentative agreement or not.

when.why: There is no tentative agreement to vote on.
You have already voted on this tentative agreement.

vote.outcome: You vote {$params.choice} on the tentative agreement.

speak.description: Say something in the union channel.

stages.name: negotiation
stages.brief: It is round {$round}. {$'The union negotiator proposes this round.' if $round % 2 == 1 else 'The company negotiator proposes this round.'} The side that receives the proposal answers it with accept or reject.

stages.name: ratification
stages.brief: A tentative agreement on a wage increase of {$world.tentative_wage|1} percent is on the table. Vote yes or no; you may also speak in the union channel. A majority of yes votes ratifies it.

then.say: The members ratify the tentative agreement: a wage increase of {$world.tentative_wage|1} percent.

else.say: The members reject the tentative agreement; talks continue.

then.say: The unanswered proposal of {$world.standing|1} percent is off the table.

do.say: The strike goes on through round {$round}: the company loses {$inputs.strike_company_cost|money} in revenue and the workers {$inputs.strike_worker_cost|money} in wages.

end.say: No deal was ratified within {$inputs.horizon} rounds: the talks have failed.

table.show: Wage increase on the table: {$world.standing|1} percent, proposed by {$world.standing_by}

status.show: Round {$round} of {$inputs.horizon} · strike: {$'yes' if $world.strike else 'no'} · rounds spent on strike so far: {$world.strike_rounds} · company revenue lost: {$world.company_losses|money} · workers' wages lost: {$world.worker_lost_wages|money}

tentative.show: Tentative agreement: {$world.tentative_wage|1} percent, awaiting the members' vote.

wage_increase.description: The ratified wage increase in percent, or null when no deal was ratified.

strike_rounds.description: Rounds that ended with the parties on strike.

ratification_votes.description: Each member's vote on the ratified deal, or null when there was none.

invariants.why: Company strike losses are exactly the strike rounds times the per-round cost.
Lost wages are exactly the strike rounds times the per-round cost.

$world.strike == false and $world.tentative == false and $world.standing == null and $round % 2 == 0
$world.strike == false and $world.tentative == false and $world.standing == null and $round % 2 == 1
$world.strike == false and $world.tentative == false and $world.standing == null and $round % 2 == 0
